_comment: Writing waves. Each page has `wave: N` in its front matter. A wave starts when the pages it depends on are at least in review. See docs/handbook/writing-order.md.

waves.name: Frame
waves.goal: Agree on the words and the boundaries: scopes, actors, governance principles, glossary.

waves.name: Direction and legal frame
waves.goal: Say what the system must achieve, under which laws, with which fundamental choices, and who is controller or processor.

waves.name: Structure
waves.goal: Draw the outline: technical context, technical constraints, the crosscutting decisions that shape the structure (ADR-0004 to ADR-0008: identity, identity link, trust boundaries, catalogue metadata, HealthData@EU connection), level-1 building blocks and the scope overviews.

waves.name: Behaviour and components
waves.goal: Describe each lifecycle scenario and each level-2 building block. Scope teams work in parallel.

waves.name: Crosscutting details
waves.goal: Detail the concepts that the scenarios and components rely on, building on the wave 3 decisions: security, identity, logging, consent, identifiers, output control, versioning, metadata, EHDS.

waves.name: Deployment, quality and consolidation
waves.goal: Deployment at central, national and local level, quality scenarios, risks, national profile template, and a final check of the reader guides.
